items.title: Final family publication identity
items.description: The final family Git commit and packet manifest/checksum and consumed-contract digests were supplied to and verified by the source lock.
items.impact: Resolved by the exact published closure commit and recorded digests.

items.title: Initial and closure repository publication
items.description: TASK-0002 must initialize Git, publish the exact private remote, record equality, and close with one narrow evidence commit.
items.impact: Remote repository foundation remains incomplete until publication evidence passes.

items.title: Suite absorbs capability semantics
items.description: Catalog normalization or UI convenience could evolve into duplicated domain semantics.
items.impact: Semantic drift, coupling, and loss of independent capability authority.

items.title: Package and suite CLI identifiers
items.description: Repository and product identity do not automatically select package, binary, or protocol names.
items.impact: Implementation naming remains gated by collision and compatibility review.

items.title: Provider, retention, signing, and numeric SLO decisions
items.description: Provider technologies, regional obligations, retention defaults, signing requirements, and numeric SLOs lack implementation evidence and owner approval.
items.impact: Production and release readiness remain unassessed.
